10

Stated limits & methodology

How to read this report

Every number in this report is computed from sources we name, under rules we publish, with its gaps stated. What follows is the full list of methods and limits - including the things this report deliberately does not claim.

  • Percentiles. Computed within one league, one season, one position group, mid-rank with ties split. Published only when at least 10 players clear the minutes gate in that peer group (270′ in our top-flight coverage, 450′ in second-tier feeder coverage) - below that the percentile is withheld, never guessed. The peer-group n is printed beside every percentile in this report.
  • Missing is never zero. A metric a competition does not collect renders as “not recorded”; a rate whose sample is below the minutes gate renders as “—”. Neither is ever shown as zero, and no number in this report is imputed.
  • Cross-league comparisons. Raw percentiles are never compared across leagues or tiers. The only cross-league number we publish is the Latent Level, which is corridor-calibrated and backtested against post-move outcomes before it appears in any report.
  • Export Index. A composite score, not a percentile: an average of five outfield percentile components with a U-21 multiplier, so it can exceed 100. Goalkeepers carry no Export Index - it contains no goalkeeping.
  • Transfer history. From our own Transfermarkt-sourced transfer record. Where identity is matched by name rather than a verified ID, the report says so and does not present the history as fact.

The Latent Level backtest, in full

Section 2 states this as one claim; these are the complete figures behind it.

Backtested level-v2.3 on 2053 abroad moves out of the seven covered leagues with a pre-move Level and Transfermarkt post-move league minutes (best of first two destination seasons, nominal 2700 min). Spearman(Level, minutes retention) = +0.116 raw; +0.082 against the retention residual once destination difficulty, loan status and age are accounted for (within-league composite alone: +0.093). 'Stuck' = >=1350 league minutes: top Level quartile 41% vs bottom quartile 27%. On step-up moves only (destination fitted stronger than origin): top-quartile 34% (n=279) vs bottom-quartile 20% (n=269). Identity join is by normalized name + birth-year (22 ambiguous names dropped); minutes retention is an availability-inclusive outcome - injuries count as failures. Secondary receipt: on 905 permanent exports with a disclosed fee, Spearman(pre-move Level, fee paid) = +0.268.

Not collected for these leagues

No provider records these for our coverage. This report will never claim them.

Event-location data. No xG, no heatmaps, no pass maps. Our sources do not carry ball coordinates for these leagues, and we do not model or fake them.

Physical data. No sprints, distances or top speeds. No source collects them for these leagues; any physical claim would be invented.

Not yet in our data

These exist at sources we already draw from but are not yet ingested. They are coverage gaps we intend to close; until then the report treats them as absent rather than guessing.

Contract terms. Contract-expiry dates exist at source but are not yet in our databases, so no figure in this report leans on contract length.

Injury and absence reasons. A gap in the match log means he was not on the pitch, and that is all it means - our data does not yet separate injury from non-selection.

Ball-carry coverage. The provider collects carry metrics for a minority of our competitions today. They appear only where a season's coverage is complete.
